Introduction

Hana is a South Korean singer, dancer, and composer under ATTRAKT. Best known for being a member of the girl group FIFTY FIFTY, she was introduced as a member on August 12, 2024, and debuted with the group on August 30, 2024, with the pre-release single "Starry Night".

Before making her debut in FIFTY FIFTY, Hana made her solo debut on June 22, 2020, with the digital single "Secret Crush".
